name: Echo Knight
summary: A warrior who fights alongside a shadowy echo from another timeline.

features.name: Manifest Echo
features.short: Bonus action: summon an echo you can attack from and swap with.
features.summary: As a bonus action, create an echo of yourself within 15 ft. (AC 14 + PB, 1 hit point). You can make attacks from its space, swap places with it for 15 ft. of movement, and make opportunity attacks from it.

features.name: Unleash Incarnation
features.short: Make an extra attack from your echo.
features.summary: When you take the Attack action, you can make one additional melee attack from your echo's position. Uses: CON modifier per long rest.

features.name: Echo Avatar
features.short: See and hear through your echo, up to 1,000 ft. away.
features.summary: As an action, you can temporarily see and hear through your echo for up to 10 minutes; it can move up to 1,000 ft. away while you do.

features.name: Shadow Martyr
features.short: Reaction: teleport your echo to take an attack for an ally.
features.summary: When a creature you can see within 5 ft. of your echo is attacked, you can teleport your echo between them; the attack hits the echo. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Reclaim Potential
features.short: When your echo is destroyed, gain temp HP.
features.summary: When your echo is destroyed by damage, you gain 2d6 + CON temporary hit points if you have none. Uses: CON modifier per long rest.

features.name: Legion of One
features.short: Create two echoes; regain an Unleash use at initiative.
features.summary: You can create two echoes at once, and if you have no uses of Unleash Incarnation when you roll initiative, you regain one.
